credentials.purpose: App Store Connect API authentication
credentials.redaction_requirements: Never log private key. Hash key_id for evidence.
credentials.recommended_rig_handling: Store encrypted. Use via Rig credential manager.
credentials.compromise_impact: Attacker can upload builds, manage TestFlight.

credentials.purpose: Code signing for development and distribution
credentials.redaction_requirements: Never log private key. Log certificate SHA1 fingerprint only.
credentials.recommended_rig_handling: Store in macOS Keychain or CI vault. Monitor expiration.
credentials.compromise_impact: Attacker can sign malware as your identity.

credentials.purpose: Links app ID, certificate, and entitlements
credentials.redaction_requirements: Store profile. Hash profile UUID for evidence.
credentials.recommended_rig_handling: Store as build artifact. Validate before signing.
credentials.compromise_impact: Lower than certificate. Allows unauthorized device enrollment.

credentials.purpose: Notarization via App Store Connect API key
credentials.redaction_requirements: Never log private key. Hash key_id.
credentials.recommended_rig_handling: API key stored in keychain. notarytool --keychain-profile.
credentials.compromise_impact: Attacker can submit malware for notarization.

credentials.purpose: Google Play Developer API access
credentials.redaction_requirements: Never log JSON key file contents. Hash service account email.
credentials.recommended_rig_handling: Minimal scopes. Service account per pipeline. Store in secure vault.
credentials.compromise_impact: Catastrophic — attacker can publish any app under developer account.
credentials.remaining_unknowns: Play Console role granularity for API-only access.

credentials.purpose: Signs AAB/APK for upload to Play Console
credentials.redaction_requirements: Never log keystore password or private key. Log key fingerprint SHA256.
credentials.recommended_rig_handling: Store in CI secrets. Back up securely.
credentials.compromise_impact: Attacker can upload builds.
credentials.remaining_unknowns: Google support response time for key reset.

credentials.purpose: Partner Center API access for Store submissions
credentials.redaction_requirements: Never log client secret. Hash tenant_id+client_id.
credentials.recommended_rig_handling: Azure Key Vault or CI vault. Rotate regularly.
credentials.compromise_impact: Attacker can manage app submissions, update listings.
credentials.remaining_unknowns: Exact Azure AD permission set for Store-only access.

credentials.purpose: Code signing certificate for Windows binaries and MSIX
credentials.redaction_requirements: Never log private key. Log certificate thumbprint.
credentials.recommended_rig_handling: HSM if possible. CI vault minimum. Monitor expiration.
credentials.compromise_impact: Attacker can sign malware as your identity.
credentials.remaining_unknowns: EV vs standard certificate SmartScreen behavior.

credentials.purpose: Publish packages to npm registry
credentials.redaction_requirements: Never log token. Hash token prefix for evidence.
credentials.recommended_rig_handling: Granular tokens with minimal scope. 2FA required. Prefer OIDC.
credentials.compromise_impact: Attacker can publish malicious versions of packages.

credentials.purpose: Passwordless npm publishing via OIDC trusted publishers
credentials.redaction_requirements: No token to redact. Provenance attestation is content-light.
credentials.recommended_rig_handling: Preferred over tokens. Use in CI.
credentials.compromise_impact: Attacker with repo write access can publish. No credential to steal.

credentials.purpose: Publish Python packages to PyPI
credentials.redaction_requirements: Never log token. Hash token prefix for evidence.
credentials.recommended_rig_handling: Project-scoped tokens. Prefer Trusted Publishers (OIDC).
credentials.compromise_impact: Attacker can publish malicious packages under your name.

credentials.purpose: Passwordless PyPI publishing via OIDC trusted publishers
credentials.redaction_requirements: No token. Attestation is content-light.
credentials.recommended_rig_handling: Preferred over API tokens.
credentials.compromise_impact: Repo write access allows publish. No credential to exfiltrate.

credentials.purpose: Publish Rust crates to crates.io
credentials.redaction_requirements: Never log token. Hash token for evidence.
credentials.recommended_rig_handling: Use publish-update scope. Store in CI secrets.
credentials.compromise_impact: Catastrophic — publishes permanent crate versions.

credentials.purpose: GitHub access for tap repo push, PR creation, bottle upload
credentials.redaction_requirements: Never log token. Hash token prefix for evidence.
credentials.recommended_rig_handling: Fine-grained PAT or GitHub App. Minimal scope.
credentials.compromise_impact: Repo write access. Attacker can modify formula/cask.

credentials.purpose: Create GitHub Releases and upload assets
credentials.redaction_requirements: Never log token. Use GITHUB_TOKEN in CI (ephemeral). Hash for evidence.
credentials.recommended_rig_handling: Use GITHUB_TOKEN where possible. Fine-grained PAT otherwise.
credentials.compromise_impact: Attacker can create releases, modify tags.

credentials.purpose: Deploy to GitHub Pages
credentials.redaction_requirements: Same as GitHub release token.
credentials.recommended_rig_handling: Use GITHUB_TOKEN.
credentials.compromise_impact: Defacement of GitHub Pages site.

credentials.purpose: Push/pull container images to registry
credentials.redaction_requirements: Never log token. Hash for evidence.
credentials.recommended_rig_handling: Read-only tokens for pull. Publish tokens with minimal scope.
credentials.compromise_impact: Attacker can push malicious images.

credentials.purpose: Sign container images and attestations with cosign
credentials.redaction_requirements: Never log private key. Never commit cosign.key.
credentials.recommended_rig_handling: Prefer keyless (OIDC). If using key, store in KMS/HSM.
credentials.compromise_impact: Attacker can sign malicious images as your identity.

credentials.purpose: Sign git tags, release artifacts with GPG
credentials.redaction_requirements: Never log private key. Log key fingerprint.
credentials.recommended_rig_handling: Use hardware token (YubiKey). CI: use SSH signing or GitHub's own.
credentials.compromise_impact: Trust anchor broken. All signatures become suspect.

credentials.purpose: Git operations via SSH. Tag signing.
credentials.redaction_requirements: Never log private key. Log public key fingerprint.
credentials.recommended_rig_handling: Deploy keys with read-only or write per repo.
credentials.compromise_impact: Attacker can push commits, modify releases.

credentials.purpose: Keyless signing via OIDC identity (Sigstore/Fulcio/Rekor)
credentials.redaction_requirements: No key. OIDC token is ephemeral.
credentials.recommended_rig_handling: Preferred signing model. Use in CI. No key management.
credentials.compromise_impact: Attacker with workflow access can sign. No long-lived credential.
